improved: The scheduled release script reports release timing, saved status and local timer health without executing or changing a release.

added: Admin Backup & Recovery with manual and scheduled backups, restore safeguards, health reporting and offline recovery.
Backups are encrypted with authenticated AES-256-GCM and stored on a configurable persistent local backup directory.
System email notifications with independent administrator preferences and delivery diagnostics.
A persistent in-app notification center with unread tracking and severity-based colors.
improved: Automatic backup scheduling, automatic-only retention and cleanup reporting protect recovery archives.
Personal successful-backup notification preferences are available from the Settings page, with notification history kept separately.
System email notifications use Armory Ledger branding with a responsive HTML layout and plain-text fallback.
Release automation verifies the published container identity before marking the newest stable GitHub release as Latest.
A daily check notifies administrators when the public GHCR latest image contains a newer Armory Ledger version.
fixed: Notification controls fit desktop and mobile navigation; the notification popover matches the site palette, and closes when clicking outside it.
Administrators can inspect database, backup/recovery and email status from the footer; backup and email settings pages use more compact layouts.
Heritage rule colors now appear in red, ivory and blue order.
upgrade_notes: Apply the v0.1.4 migration, mount persistent backup storage, configure and preserve ARMORY_BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY outside the server, provision a separate SMTP encryption key if needed, and sign in again to synchronize administrator membership.

added: Shooting Log activity types: Range Session, Hunting, Training, Defensive Action and Other.
Recorded Rounds Fired and Shooting History on firearm records.
Compatible ammunition lot merging with archived source records and preserved history.
improved: Ammunition choices are filtered by the selected firearm's caliber.
Announcement scheduling supports IANA timezones, UTC previews and explicit daylight-saving choices.
Shared calendar controls offer direct month/year selection and 24-hour time entry.
fixed: Merge confirmation distinguishes completed merges from uncertain outcomes and redirects successful merges to the destination lot.
Shooting Log expenditure descriptions reflect the activity type.
Merge-history links use consistent visited and keyboard-focus styles.
upgrade_notes: Includes database migrations for activity types and lot merging. Back up the database before upgrading.
Lot-merging downgrade is blocked when merge history exists; recovery requires a reviewed forward fix or a compatible backup restore.

added: Administration pages for account identities and read-only shared manufacturer/caliber reference data.
About / Privacy page with optional instance contact information.
improved: Optional firearm serial numbers and optional USD purchase prices.
upgrade_notes: Includes firearm and announcement database migrations. Release date follows the repository's v0.1.2 tag.

improved: Container publication, startup migration handling and deployment documentation.
upgrade_notes: Release date follows the v0.1.1 tag. Historical notes summarize the tagged source changes; a complete original release narrative is not available here.

added: Initial tagged release with firearm, ammunition and accessory records, range-session logging and ownership-aware record keeping.
